The '''Iridium Needle''' is a [[Weapons#Dagger|dagger weapon]] that has a 14% chance of dropping from [[Slimes#Special Slimes|special Slimes]] in [[The Mines|The Mines]] during Qi's challenge [[Quests#Danger In The Deep|Danger In The Deep]] and after the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]] has been activated.

==Notes==
The Iridium Needle has the highest base critical strike chance and crit power of any weapon. With full investment into critical-boosting equipment and professions, it can achieve a [[Crit. Chance|critical strike chance]] of 48.99% with each critical hit dealing 14x damage, and 60.01% with +9 [[Luck|Luck]] from [[Cooking|Food]] and [[Forge#Combined Rings|combining rings]] for maximum [[Crit. Chance|critical strike chance]].<ref name="critchance" />
